name: Solidity Lsp
description: Solidity language server plugin for Claude Code — go-to-definition, hover, diagnostics, and autocomplete for .sol files
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install solidity-lsp@claude-community` from `Alexlexer/solidity-lsp`.

Solidity language server for Claude Code, providing code intelligence, diagnostics, and analysis for smart contract development.
